description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration class for the Hono LoRa adapter, including bean definitions, configuration properties, and validation logic.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for Hono LoRa Protocol Adapter, manages bean creation, configuration validation, and metrics setup.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the adapter's HTTP properties to ensure authentication is required; throws exception if not.

methods.name: loraProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of LoraProtocolAdapter.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for downstream sender factory properties if not already set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for registration client factory properties if not already set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for credentials client factory properties if not already set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for tenant client factory properties if not already set.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean to instantiate LoraProtocolAdapter instances.

methods.name: cacheManager
methods.description: Provides a simple in-memory cache manager.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures metrics registry with common tags specific to the Lora protocol adapter.
